MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The fourth-generation Echo Dot feels like a useful next addition because hands-free Alexa commands would complement my Fire TV devices.",
    "The Alexa-compatible smart plug gives me a new use for voice control, such as controlling a lamp, rather than duplicating something I already own."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The previous-generation Fire TV Stick duplicates functions I already have through my Fire TV Stick 4K and Fire TV television.",
    "The older Echo speakers interest me less when I would choose just one newer compact Dot to try first.",
    "The SSD and garage remotes address needs I have not expressed, while the memory cards require a specific recording need and confirmed camera compatibility before I would choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Fire TV devices seems to have been taken as a reason to recommend more streaming devices, even though I already have that need covered.",
    "My interest in home electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in computer upgrades and replacement remotes without a clear connection to what I need now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more interested in adding a useful capability to my existing setup than buying another device that does the same job.",
    "My interest in Alexa speakers does not mean I want several generations of them; I would start with one fourth-generation Dot.",
    "Buying a camera makes recording storage potentially relevant, but I still need to know that the card fits my camera and serves a current need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in connected home entertainment but missed the distinction between useful additions, redundant devices, and accessories without a confirmed need."
}
